projection.lonlat_to_px: x_m = R * radians(lon); y_m = R * ln(tan(pi/4 + radians(lat)/2)); px = (x_m - bbox_3857[0]) / (bbox_3857[2] - bbox_3857[0]) * width; py = (bbox_3857[3] - y_m) / (bbox_3857[3] - bbox_3857[1]) * height; (0,0) = top-left corner of the image, pixel centres at +0.5

resolution.definition: plate px per Blue Marble px (max of x/y); > 1 = upscaled
